📢 What’s Trending in 2025 Flooring? 🏡✨

1️⃣ Luxury Vinyl Plank (LVP) 🚪🔥
✔ Durable, waterproof & ultra-realistic → A must-have!
✔ Wider planks → Create a spacious, high-end look!
✔ Textured finishes → Enhanced wood grain for a true luxury feel ✨

2️⃣ Warm tones are taking over! 🎨🌿
✔ Browns, beiges & taupes → Cozy, inviting, and timeless 🏠
✔ Wood-look tiles & LVP → Bringing natural warmth indoors 🌾
✔ Goodbye cool grays! → 2025 is all about warm, earthy hues 🔥

💬 Which style do you love more? Drop your thoughts below! 👇
